newsitem.title: HONG KONG: INSIGHT-HK's Hang Seng seen retesting 15,300 level.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-HK's Hang Seng seen retesting 15,300 level.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index is expected to push to slightly higher levels then retreat before the close on Thursday in volatile, futures-related trading, brokers said.
"We could see a continuation of yesterday's rebound to 15,300 then undergo a correction," said Charles Cheung at J&A Securities.
The blue-chip index closed 174.06 points, or 1.17 percent, higher at 15,065.02 on Wednesday after storming to a high of 15,200.96 early in the day.
Overnight, the Hang Seng London Reference Index inched up 7.33 points, or 0.05 percent, to 15,072.35.
